meta.name: Generate mobile QA test cases and coverage gaps with ClickUp and Claude

name: AI Mobile App Test Case Generator

parameters.content:
## AI Mobile App Test Case Generator

Triggered by a new feature/requirement in ClickUp (webhook) or a manual test run. Pulls the requirement text, related app context (platform, screen, prior test coverage), and any linked design/spec, then asks Claude to generate a structured set of mobile test scenarios (functional, edge case, platform-specific iOS/Android, accessibility, performance) with steps and expected results. Creates a ClickUp testing task per scenario (or one grouped task with checklist items), waits for QA to log results, collects the outcomes, then asks Claude to review coverage against the original requirement and flag any missing/untested scenarios — opening a follow-up task if gaps are found.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: ClickUp API, Anthropic API (header auth, x-api-key), and (optionally) a design/spec source (Figma/Confluence) API
3. Edit Set - Config: clickupRequirementListId, clickupTestingListId, clickupResultsListId, targetPlatforms, defaultResultsWaitDays
4. Set up the ClickUp webhook (or automation) to POST to Webhook - New Requirement Created when a new task is created/moved into the requirements list
5. Activate the workflow, or use the Manual Trigger to test end to end

### Requirements
- ClickUp API access (read requirement tasks, create testing tasks, read task/checklist status)
- Anthropic API access (Claude)
- (Optional) Figma/Confluence API access for linked spec context

### How to customize
- Adjust the test-scenario categories requested from Claude (functional, edge case, negative, accessibility, performance, offline/connectivity, permissions, push notifications, deep links, platform-specific)
- Change whether each scenario becomes its own ClickUp task or a single task with checklist items
- Tune defaultResultsWaitDays to match your QA sprint cadence
- Feed prior coverage-gap findings back into future prompts so generated scenarios improve over time

## 1. Trigger & Requirement Context Gathering

Set - Config centralizes ClickUp list ids, target platforms, and the results wait window.

Webhook - New Requirement Created (or Manual Trigger - Test Run) fires when a new feature/requirement is created in ClickUp.

HTTP Request - Fetch Requirement Task Details pulls the full requirement description, custom fields, and attachments from ClickUp.

HTTP Request - Fetch Existing Test Coverage For Feature looks up any prior testing tasks tagged to the same feature/screen, so Claude knows what's already covered and won't duplicate scenarios.

## 2. AI Test Scenario Generation

HTTP Request - Claude: Generate Mobile Test Scenarios sends the requirement text, target platforms, and existing coverage, and asks for a structured list of test scenarios: category (functional/edge case/negative/accessibility/performance/platform-specific), title, precondition, steps, expected result, platform (iOS/Android/both), and priority.

JS - Parse Test Scenarios parses the response safely and fans out into one item per scenario.

## 3. Testing Task Creation

HTTP Request - Create ClickUp Testing Task opens one QA task per generated scenario in the testing list, with steps and expected result in the description, tagged by platform and priority.

JS - Attach Task Id to Scenario Record carries the created task id forward so results can be matched back to the right scenario later.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Results Collection & Gap Analysis

parameters.content:
## 4. Results Collection & Coverage Gap Analysis

Wait - For QA Results pauses for the configured window so QA has time to execute the scenarios.

HTTP Request - Fetch All Testing Task Results pulls status/comments for every testing task created for this requirement.

JS - Aggregate Results builds a summary of pass/fail/blocked counts and collects the executed scenario list.

HTTP Request - Claude: Identify Missing Scenarios sends the original requirement plus the executed scenario list and asks Claude to flag any untested edge cases, platform gaps, or missing coverage.

IF - Gaps Found routes to HTTP Request - Create Follow-Up Coverage Task (opens a ClickUp task listing the missing scenarios) or Set - Coverage Complete (no gaps, logged as fully covered).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 3000, system: "You are a senior mobile QA engineer. Given a feature/requirement description, target platforms, and a list of already-covered scenarios, generate a comprehensive set of NEW mobile test scenarios that are not already covered. Cover these categories where relevant: functional, edge case, negative, accessibility, performance, offline/connectivity, permissions, push notifications, deep links, and platform-specific (iOS vs Android) behavior. Respond with ONLY a JSON object: { scenarios: [ { category: string, title: string, platform: 'iOS'|'Android'|'Both', priority: 'high'|'medium'|'low', precondition: string, steps: string[], expectedResult: string } ] }.", messages: [ { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ requirementTitle: $json.requirementTitle, requirementDescription: $json.requirementDescription, targetPlatforms: $json.targetPlatforms, existingScenarioSummaries: $json.existingScenarioSummaries }, null, 2) } ] }) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ name: '[' + $json.category + '/' + $json.platform + '] ' + $json.title, description: 'Requirement: ' + $json.requirementTitle + ' (ref: ' + $json.requirementId + ')

Precondition: ' + $json.precondition + '

Steps:
- ' + $json.steps.join('
- ') + '

Expected result:
' + $json.expectedResult, priority: $json.priority === 'high' ? 1 : ($json.priority === 'medium' ? 3 : 4), tags: [ $json.platform.toLowerCase(), $json.category.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'), String($json.requirementId) ] }) }}
